name: Tehtris EDR
description: Tehtris XDR/EDR: host isolation, file quarantine and restore, and read-only endpoint posture. A fork of the Splunk-published Tehtris app v1.0.1.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for each Tehtris API call (default 30, at most 300)

actions.description: Validate the asset configuration for connectivity using supplied configuration

from_date.description: Seconds since EPOCH in UTC timezone of the starting date from when fetch the events.

to_date.description: Seconds since EPOCH in UTC timezone of the ending date to fetch the events. Leave blank to fetch events until now

limit.description: Page size used while paging through events, 1 to 1000 (Tehtris' maximum). Defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of events to skip before starting to collect the result set.

filter_id.description: The Filter ID used to retrieve events, if no filterId is specified in query the first filter Id store with API Key is used.

actions.description: Send a host to the isolation module
actions.verbose: The hostname must match one enrolled endpoint exactly (case-insensitive); refused when several endpoints share it. summary.applied is false when Tehtris answers 202 (queued for an agent that is not connected). Confirm with get isolation status.

hostname.description: Hostname to be sent for isolation

example_values: Sent the request to isolate ws-finance-01 (uuid ffdf773d-b124-4387-b772-a87ec08640c2)

actions.verbose: The hostname must match one enrolled endpoint exactly (case-insensitive); refused when several endpoints share it. summary.applied is false when Tehtris answers 202 (queued for an agent that is not connected). Confirm with get isolation status.

hostname.description: Hostname to be removed from isolation

example_values: Sent the request to release from isolation ws-finance-01 (uuid ffdf773d-b124-4387-b772-a87ec08640c2)

actions.description: Get process tree from a process

create_time.description: Local created time of the process

pid.description: Database id of the process to use to build the tree

actions.description: Set an endpoint's tags (may replace its existing tags)
actions.verbose: The hostname must match one enrolled endpoint exactly (case-insensitive); refused when several endpoints share it. Warning: Tehtris takes one tag string per call and does not say whether it replaces the endpoint's tags, so treat it as replacing them: read them with get host detail first.

tag.description: Tag string in Tehtris' 'XXX_tags' pattern (trigram, underscore, tags); may replace the endpoint's tags

example_values: Set tags 'ABC_isolated' on ws-finance-01 (uuid ffdf773d-b124-4387-b772-a87ec08640c2); this may have replaced the endpoint's existing tags

actions.description: Create new application policy based on sha256
actions.verbose: Creates one application policy with a single Sha256 rule. Tehtris scopes it by appliance, so it covers every endpoint on the listed hosts' appliances, not only those hosts. Hostnames must match enrolled endpoints exactly (case-insensitive).

order.description: Order the rule applies to a matching binary

example_values: Successfully posted new app policy for ffdf773d-b124-4387-b772-a87ec08640c2

actions.description: Get the current EDR isolation state of a host
actions.verbose: The host's isolation flag (status). With no state returned (HTTP 204) summary.isolated is null: treat it as unknown, never as not isolated.

hostname.description: Hostname to read isolation status for

actions.description: Get EDR inventory detail for a host
actions.verbose: Every endpoint named exactly hostname, most recently seen first; the summary describes the first. An unknown host succeeds with total_hosts 0 and the not-found reason as its message. os and versions are in raw_json.

hostname.description: Hostname to look up in the EDR inventory

actions.description: List processes seen on a host over a time window
actions.verbose: A process listing (unlike list processes, a tree around a seed pid), bounded by time_from/time_to. Reads the first page of Tehtris' cursor, so limit caps the result.

limit.description: Maximum number of processes to return

actions.description: Get the operating system details of a host
actions.verbose: Live OS details: name, type, architecture, release, version. Tehtris lists only Windows, so another OS may answer 501.

hostname.description: Hostname to fetch system information for

actions.description: Get live network activity (netstat) for a host
actions.verbose: Live netstat from the EDR agent; rows are keyed by the column names each reply carries (not in Tehtris' reference). Live: needs the EDR agent connected (504 otherwise).

hostname.description: Hostname to fetch network activity for

actions.description: Get hashes, version and signatures of a file on a host
actions.verbose: The file's hashes, original name, versions and code signatures. No such file (HTTP 204) succeeds with summary.file_found false. Live: needs the EDR agent connected (504 otherwise).

path.description: Full path of the file on the host

actions.description: List the software installed on a host
actions.verbose: The installed software, rows keyed by the column names each reply carries. Live: needs the EDR agent connected (504 otherwise).

actions.description: List the files in quarantine on a host
actions.verbose: One record per quarantined file with its quarantinePath, the path restore file takes. Live: needs the EDR agent connected (504 otherwise).

hostname.description: Hostname to list quarantined files for

actions.description: Move a file on a host into Tehtris quarantine
actions.verbose: The hostname must match one enrolled endpoint exactly (case-insensitive); refused when several endpoints share it. summary.applied is false when Tehtris answers 202 (queued for an agent that is not connected). 409 is a conflict. Undo with list quarantined files, then restore file with the quarantine path. Live: needs the EDR agent connected (504 otherwise).

path.description: Full path of the file to quarantine

notification.description: Windows only: a message shown to the endpoint user (format undocumented; blank sends none)

example_values: Sent the request to quarantine C:\Users\asmith\invoice.exe on ws-finance-01 (uuid ffdf773d-b124-4387-b772-a87ec08640c2)

actions.description: Restore a quarantined file on a host
actions.verbose: The hostname must match one enrolled endpoint exactly (case-insensitive); refused when several endpoints share it. quarantine_path is the path in quarantine (quarantinePath from list quarantined files), not the original; summary.restored_path is where the file went back. summary.applied is false when Tehtris answers 202 (queued for an agent that is not connected). Live: needs the EDR agent connected (504 otherwise).

quarantine_path.description: The file's path in quarantine, from 'list quarantined files' (quarantinePath)
